summary.result: The monitoring results from actual paddy rice fields and experimental paddy plots showed that concentrations of indicator microorganisms ranged from $10^2\;to\;10^5$ MPN/100mL.
summary.background: A study was performed to examine the effects of reclaimed-water irrigation on microorganism con-centration in ponded-water of paddy rice plots.
summary.method: Treatments with UV-disinfected water irrigation demonstrated significantly lower concentrations than others including control plots where natural surface water was irrigated.

summary_ko.method: 자외선 살균수 관개 처리는 자연수로 관개한 대조구를 포함한 다른 처리들과 비교하여 유의하게 낮은 농도를 보였다.
summary_ko.result: 실제 논밭과 실험 논 플롯에서의 모니터링 결과는 지표 미생물 농도가 $10^2\;to\;10^5$ MPN/100mL 범위에 있음을 보여주었다.
